chapter: Club culture, radio and the rise of R&B
title: Rhythm and blues versus rock and roll
summary: Tad Jones asks if there is a difference between R&B and rock and roll; Stephens says rock and roll was an offshoot and race music was the label used.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: How do you see the difference? Is there any difference between rhythm and blues and rock and roll? I mean, did you see a difference?

Well, let's put it this way. Rock and roll was the offshoot of what was being played and being delivered by. See, when blacks, when white disc jackets would pick up a record, and it was a black artist that they knew or recognized, even Louis Armstrong, they would call that race music. I think we went through this once before. But now, to answer your question, there is a thin line difference. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Thank you.
